abstract.text: Revoke unused, lost, or compromised private keys.

prose.text: Once you revoke an API key, you can’t reinstate it. Revoked keys are displayed for 30 days on the API Keys page under the Revoked heading.
Admins can prevent a user from creating an Individual Key by removing the Generate Individual API Keys permission.

paragraphs.text: Revoke an API key immediately if it becomes inactive, lost, or compromised. A revoked API key denies access to the App Store Connect API on your organization’s behalf.

> **Important**
>
>  Once you revoke an API key, you can’t reinstate it. Revoked keys are displayed for 30 days on the API Keys page under the Revoked heading.
To revoke a team API key, log in to `https://appstoreconnect.apple.com/` with an Admin account.

listItems.text: Select Users and Access, then select the Keys tab.
Click Edit next to the list of Active keys.
Select the API keys to revoke, and click Revoke Key.
Click the Revoke button to confirm.

paragraphs.text: There are two ways to revoke an individual API key, depending on your role. Begin both methods by logging in to App Store Connect.
To revoke keys for another user, as an Admin:

> **Tip**
>
>  Admins can prevent a user from creating an Individual Key by removing the Generate Individual API Keys permission.

listItems.text: Select Users and Access, then select the Keys tab.
Click Edit next to the list of Active keys.
Select the API keys to revoke, and click Revoke Key.
Click the Revoke button to confirm.
Scroll down to Individual API Key.
Click the Revoke button to confirm.
